spans.s:
n. (-णं)
1 Any glass vessel.
2 The mucus of the nose.
3 Rust of iron.
E.
शिघि to smell, आणक Uṇādi affix, and the final optionally rejected; also शिंघाणक and शिंहाणक.

n. (-णं)
The mucus of the nose.
E.
शिघि to smell, Uṇādi aff. आनक्, and the last syllable of the aff. optionally rejected; also सिंघाणक. n. (-कं) सिंहाण, &c.

m. (-कः)
Phlegm.
mn. (-कः-कं)
The mucus of the nose.
E.
शिघि to smell, aff. आणक.

n. (-कं)
The mucus of the nose.
E.
see the last.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Smelled.
E.
शिघि to smell, aff. क्त.

f. (-नी)
The nose.
E.
शिघि to smell, affs. इनि and ङीप्, and the initial changed.
